feeds.title: Slummy single mummy
feeds.description: The secret diary of a slummy single mummy. Blog covers a range of different topics, including recipes, blogging tips and product reviews. I started Slummy Single Mummy back in 2009 and my blog covers everything from UK mini breaks to pension planning.

feeds.title: Who's the Mummy?
feeds.description: Welcome to Who's the Mummy, a blog by journalist and Single Mummy Sally Whittle, and 12-year-old daughter, Flea. This blog is packed with travel tips, activity ideas, parenting hacks and ideas for parents of tweens and teens.

feeds.title: Confessions of a Single Mum
feeds.description: The ups, the downs and sideways views of life as a single parent.

feeds.title: Northern Mum
feeds.description: I'm Jane - a working single mum of three. We have had our share of health problems in the last couple of years and I use this space to share our experiences and keep my sanity. I write a lot about type1 diabetes and Hip Dyplasia and I try whenever possible to make my readers laugh.

feeds.title: MotherGeek
feeds.description: A geeky lifestyle, parenting and travel blog, written by a 30 something Mum, based in Manchester, UK.

feeds.title: Life with Sonia
feeds.description: My name is Sonia Seivwright. I am a lifestyle blogger, content creator, author, YouTuber and single mum. I will be sharing some topics based on my life, fun, family-based, personal, motivating and hopefully inspiring.

feeds.title: Slummy single mummy
feeds.description: Covers everything from UK mini breaks to pension planning. Jo also works as a speaker, trainer, commercial copywriter and journalist.

feeds.title: Meet Mel from The Stork and I
feeds.description: Meet Mel Johnson, an experienced life coach and the founder of the Stork and I, a coaching company for single women wanting to have a baby on their own.

feeds.title: Mummy in a Tutu
feeds.description: Mummy in a Tutu is a UK blog by Katie, a single mum who writes about her life with her daughter. She shares honest stories about being a single parent, tips for family life, home and money advice, and ideas.

feeds.title: Single Mother Ahoy Blog
feeds.description: Covers a mixture of lifestyle, parenting, self development and general ramblings. Single Mother Ahoy is about fun and frolics as a single mother!

feeds.title: Shuvonshuvoff Blog
feeds.description: Siobhan (62) retired from the BBC two years ago, after a 30-year career working as a Reporter, Presenter and Producer in local News. She uses her blog, published articles and public speaking activities, to challenge and change the narrative around ageing, to inspire as many women as possible, to step out of their comfort zone and follow their retirement dreams.

feeds.title: Steph Nimmo
feeds.description: This is the story of my family, and how we are learning to thrive and not just survive when life didn't go quite as we planned. I'm Steph, a suburban mother, sometime Marketing Director, now family plate spinner, journalist, carer, nurse, spokesperson, campaigner, and marathon runner (actual as well as metaphorical). My life was never going to be predictable but as Andy always said, it is what it is, it's how you respond which makes the difference.

feeds.title: Tanya Dreams
feeds.description: Tanya Dreams is lifestyle blog for working single mothers. Focusing on rediscovering self and resurrecting dreams, goals and passions. Covering single parenting, lifestyle, interior design and well-being.

feeds.title: Mum in a Nutshell
feeds.description: Mum, in a Nutshell, is a family lifestyle blog by Devon's single mum. Here, you'll find articles on homes, healthy lifestyles, relationships, single parenting as well as recipes, review and more.

feeds.title: Frolo Blog
feeds.description: Frolo is the online hub for single parents with 2 separate modes: a community for friendship and support and dating.
